=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text hdr "first 199 terms of the Moebius sequence (the first cell, n = 0, is blank):\n"
text blank "   "
text tneg " -1"
text tzer "  0"
text tpos "  1"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note mu(n) by trial division: 0 if some prime divides n twice, else (-1)^(number of prime factors)
note bound: n < 200, so d walks fewer than 15 values with d * d <= n
fn mu n ulong to long
v = n
s = long 1
d = ulong 2
while le mul d d v bound 200
if eq rem v d 0
v = div v d
if eq rem v d 0
ret 0
end
s = sub long 0 s
end
d = add d 1
end
if gt v 1
s = sub long 0 s
end
ret s
end
fn main to int
emit hdr
for r ulong 10
for c ulong 20
n = add mul r 20 c
if eq n 0
emit blank
else
m = mu n
if lt m 0
emit tneg
end
if eq m 0
emit tzer
end
if gt m 0
emit tpos
end
end
end
emit nl
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
